text: Currently, Bicknell Avenue, from Rogers Road to Eglinton Avenue West, has no speed humps. There are two schools located on Bicknell Avenue between Rogers Road and Eglinton Avenue West. This will ensure the safety of students. The locations of the proposed speed humps are shown on attached drawings (EY18-080A and EY18-080B).

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Requested the City Clerk to survey eligible householders in English or any other language specified by Community Council, on Bicknell Avenue, from Rogers Road to Eglinton Avenue West to determine if property owners/occupants support the installation and circulate Drawing #'s EY18-080A and EY18-080B to residents during the polling process, according to the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the survey, Etobicoke York Community Council: a. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Bicknell Avenue, from Rogers Road to Eglinton Avenue West, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on Drawing #EY18-080A and EY18-080B. b. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Bicknell Avenue, from Rogers Road to Eglinton Avenue West, when the speed humps are installed.
